business_summary: BRUNO,Inc. engages in the wholesale and retail businesses in Japan and internationally. It provides lifestyle products, including interior goods, home appliances, travel goods, and cosmetics and beauty products under the BRUNO and MILESTO brand names. The company also plans and creates concepts and designs for products; and provides brand tie-ups, original design development, and product name engraving services. It sells its product online. The company was formerly known as IDEA International Co., Ltd. and changed its name to BRUNO,Inc. in October 2021. BRUNO,Inc. was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan. The company operates as a subsidiary of RIZAP GROUP, Inc.
